title: AVENIQ Company Brain Global Settings & RAG Runtime Configuration
raw_content:
# AVENIQ Company Brain Global Settings & RAG Runtime Configuration

brain_version: "1.0.0"
environment: "production"

default_language: "en"
default_tone: "professional"

embedding_model: "text-embedding-3-large"
embedding_dimensions: 3072

chunk_size: 1000
chunk_overlap: 200
chunking_strategy: "semantic_heading_split"

retrieval:
  top_k: 8
  min_relevance_score: 0.72
  context_window_budget_tokens: 4000

rerank:
  enabled: true
  provider: "cohere-rerank-v3"
  top_n_after_rerank: 5

hybrid_search:
  enabled: true
  vector_weight: 0.7
  bm25_weight: 0.3

knowledge_graph:
  enabled: true
  traverse_depth: 2
  edge_confidence_threshold: 0.8

vector_database:
  engine: "postgres_pgvector"
  table_name: "company_brain_embeddings"
  index_type: "hnsw"
  distance_metric: "cosine"

cache:
  enabled: true
  provider: "redis"
  ttl_seconds: 86400

data_lifecycle:
  supported_states:
    - Draft
    - Reviewed
    - Approved
    - Embedded
    - Indexed
    - Active
    - Archived
  default_active_state: "Active"
